notes.title: Easter Main Menu Mini Game
notes.content:
[h3]Tired of playing the Vickys as you wait for multiplayer to come back? You're not alone[i]! [/i][/h3]

To placate the masses, we offer you the Main Menu Mini game... which will undoubtedly become a multiplayer game itself, but that's really not the point at the moment...

Anyway, Enjoy[i]![/i]

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
